name: Jeatherai
overview: Jeatherai is a male member of the tribe of Levi, specifically identified as a Gershonite, which means he descends from Gershon, son of Levi. He is noted as the son of Zerah, linking him within the Levitical family line responsible for specific priestly duties. His association with the Gershonites places him among those Levites assigned particular roles in the service of the tabernacle.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeatherai appears only once in Scripture and has no recorded meaning or divine origin. It is presented simply as a proper name without additional significance noted in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jeatherai as the son of Zerah, establishing a direct paternal relationship within the Levitical lineage. Beyond this, no other family relationships are documented in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Jeatherai's significance lies in his place within the Levitical genealogies, which are crucial for understanding the organization and duties of the tribe of Levi. As a Gershonite and son of Zerah, he represents a branch of the Levites tasked with specific responsibilities in the worship and service of God. His mention helps preserve the historical and spiritual heritage of the priestly families serving in Israel.
